description.text: Why choose to study this program? MASTA (Master Program on Space Technology Applications) has been an elaborately designed and an intensive Master Program on space technology applications in Beihang University since 2006, sponsored by the Secretariat of Asia-Pacific Multilateral Cooperation in Space Technology and Applications (AP-MCSTA). It focuses on both knowledge acquisition and operational training, and is an engineering and application-oriented program with flexible curricula. It provides a powerful platform for scholars and professionals to obtain more opportunities for communicating and experiencing the space technology practice in China. English will be used as teaching and instruction language. Note: Only when the number of the qualified applicants for one major is over 15 the class will be opened. Main Courses and Credits Major Courses: Introduction to Satellite Communication, Electromagnetic Wave and Antennas, Principles of Satellite Communications, The Opening of Experiments of SATCOM, Satellite Communication Networks, Rules, Regulations and Procedures of ITU, Case Studies in the Applications of Satellite Communications, Software Applications of STK etc. See more detailed course information please download the MASTA-SATCOM Curriculum Catalogue. Program Schedule MASTA will launch a two-stage program: Stage Ⅰ: 9-12 months in BUAA for the Core Course; Stage Ⅱ: 6-12 months in BUAA or home country for Advanced Research Projects. Fees Tuition Fee Period of Study Tuition Fee 9 Month Couse in BUAACNY 50000 / Person 6-12 Month Project At BUAA:CNY 30000 / Person In home country: CNY10000 / Person Accommodation Fee No.1 Dormitory Two room apartment with a bathroom and kitchenCNY 1300 / Mth. per room Da-yun-cun Dormitory No.10 BLDG Shared bed-room with a bathroomCNY 550 / Mth. per bed Single room with bathroomCNY 1100 / Mth. per room Other Fees Physical Examination: RMB 350 / Person Insurance Fee: RMB 600 / Person / Yr Diploma Awarded Students who have finished Stage Ⅰwill obtain postgraduate certificate of BUAA. Students who have finished both stages and pass the master thesis defense will be awarded a Master degree of P.R. China.

duration.text: The MASTA Program: Satellite Communications at Beihang University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 6944 USD/per year ￥ 50000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of undergraduate school 5. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record. 6. Letter of recommendation From professor or associate professor or equivalents 7. Financial support statement A certificate from the financial guarantor of the applicant.

requirements.text: 1.The Applicant should be expected to study hard, observe the laws and decrees of the Chinese government and abide by the regulations of BUAA. 2.In general the applicant should have a Bachelor of Science (B.S.) degree or have the equivalent educational background of (a B.S.) degree. 3.The applicant should be forty years of age or under. 4.The applicant must have a good command of English and have the ability to take courses in English or Chinese.
